L31·N2305unmasked layer

L31·N10803unmasked layer
This neuron activates diffusely across ordinary running prose, spiking on a short function-word/continuation token that opens the predicate or next clause right after a subject or verb (e.g. " to", " is", " will", a comma, or an upcoming-time/place complement like " tomorrow"/" Vegas"), rather than on any consistent semantic content; content nouns/adjectives mid-clause ("plans", "difficult", "property", "without") drive it negative.
